title: B1 Milestone 5: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Quinto Hito del Nivel B1. Tu vocabulario corporativo y habilidades de comunicación indirecta son excepcionales.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 21 a 24 del nivel B1: 
- Reported Speech (He said he was busy). 
- Customer Complaints (Apologize, refund, investigate).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 21 to 24 of the B1 level: Reported Speech, and vocabulary for Customer Complaints.

parts.visual:
- Prefixes & Suffixes (Underestimate, overcharge, useless). 
- Networking & Contacts (Introduce yourself, keep in touch, reach out). 
¡Demuestra lo que sabes!
parts.audio: We will also review Prefixes and Suffixes, and vocabulary for Networking and Contacts. Show what you know!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 21-24).

questions.question: Directo: 'I am tired'. -> Indirecto: He said that he ____ tired. (Estaba).
Directo: 'We will call you'. -> Indirecto: They told us they ____ call us. (Llamarían).
He ____ me that the meeting was canceled. (Me dijo).
We received a formal ____ from a client today. (Queja - sustantivo).
We sincerely ____ for the inconvenience. (Nos disculpamos).
Since the product is broken, we will ____ your money. (Reembolsar).
Never ____ your competitors. (Subestimar).
The restaurant ____ us. We paid too much! (Nos cobró de más).
The meeting was a waste of time. It was completely ____. (Inútil).
She is a very ____ employee. She anticipates problems. (Proactiva).
Let me ____ myself. My name is Alex. (Presentarme).
Let's exchange business ____. (Tarjetas de presentación).
It was nice meeting you. Let's keep in ____. (Contacto).
I will ____ out to you next week. (Contactarte / Escribirte).
Directo: 'I don't have time.' -> Indirecto: She said she ____ have time. (No tenía).
We are sorry for the ____ this has caused. (Inconveniencia / Molestia).
The new campaign was very ____. We doubled our sales! (Exitosa).
I am calling to ____ up on the email I sent yesterday. (Hacer seguimiento).
We have a lot in ____. (En común).
Directo: 'I can do it.' -> Indirecto: He said he ____ do it. (Podía).
